title: KAPSAM: open-source software for the evaluation of measurement uncertainty (GUM, Monte Carlo and top-down)

creators.name: Ün, İlker
creators.affiliation: TÜBİTAK National Metrology Institute (TÜBİTAK UME), 41470 Gebze, Kocaeli, Türkiye

description: Open-source software for the evaluation of measurement uncertainty: the GUM including its 2026 amendment, the Monte Carlo methods of JCGM 101 and 102, conformity assessment, top-down evaluation, proficiency testing, calibration with uncertainty in both variables, precision experiments, control charts, uncertainty from sampling, weighing instruments and consensus values, with reports in English and Turkish. Verified on 284 projects built from the worked examples of 36 sources, 25 of them guidance documents and standards (1841 reference values), compared with Suncal (164 projects) and recalculated with spreadsheet formulas (187 projects). Rust engine, command-line tool and a Flutter application for desktop and mobile platforms.
